senses.sense_definition: iemand die tegen betaling tijdelijk andermans kinderen in huis opvangt en verzorgt

examples.text: De <w>gastouder</w> vangt de kinderen op in een huiselijke sfeer.

target_lang_translations.en: The <w>childminder</w> looks after the children in a home-like environment.

examples.text: Veel werkende ouders kiezen voor een <w>gastouder</w> vanwege de flexibele tijden.

target_lang_translations.en: Many working parents choose a <w>childminder</w> because of the flexible hours.

target_lang_definitions.en: A person who provides childcare for other people's children in their own home for payment.

en.target_lang_sense_clarification: The most common term in British English for a professional who cares for children in their own home.
A general term used in American English for someone providing childcare services.
Often used interchangeably, though a nanny typically works in the child's home rather than their own.
